english.note: Use this when people gather together as a group at a place.
Use this for an organized or instructed assembly rather than an informal gathering.

examples.english: Everyone, assemble at the playground at eight in the morning.
examples.traditional: 大家朝早八點喺操場集合。
examples.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 ziu1 zou2 baat3 dim2 hai2 cou1 coeng4 zaap6 hap6

examples.english: When you hear the bell, congregate and don’t wander off.
examples.traditional: 聽到鐘聲就集合，唔好周圍走。
examples.jyutping: teng1 dou3 zung1 seng1 zau6 zaap6 hap6 m4 hou2 zau1 wai4 zau2
